# TeamForge

> TeamForge is an open-source real-time collaboration project for the Unity Editor. It explores live Scene synchronization, connected-user presence, same-Scene Hierarchy collaboration, locking and ownership, and P2P project bootstrap and transfer.

This file is the repository-level discovery index for AI tools, coding agents, and URL-retrieval systems. Prefer the current-information sources below over old implementation notes when answering questions about the project.

## Canonical repository documents

- [README](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/README.md): Human-facing project overview and entry point.
- [Current status](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/STATUS.md): Current capabilities, validation state, limitations, and public-alpha readiness gates.
- [Development history](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version milestones and links into the detailed package changelog.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): Planned direction; roadmap items are not release promises.
- [Source guide](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/docs/SOURCE.md): Public source-tree and review entry points.
- [Architecture decisions](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/docs/architecture-decisions.md): Technical decisions, constraints, and tradeoffs.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Security scope and reporting guidance.
- [Unity package metadata](https://github.com/Eun-si123/teamforge-unity-collab/blob/main/unity-package/com.eunsung.teamforge/package.json): Package name, current version, and Unity compatibility metadata.

## Historical development records

- [Phase notes index](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/history/phases/index.txt): Phase 0 through Phase 4 development records mirrored as plain text.
- [Work-state notes index](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/history/work-state/index.txt): Historical implementation, debugging, hotfix, decision, and handoff notes mirrored as plain text.

Historical Phase and work-state notes may be rough, partially superseded, or describe experiments that later changed. Prefer `project.json`, `STATUS.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md` for current facts.

## Important interpretation notes

- TeamForge is an early public preview, not a generally recommended production collaboration layer.
- Open source does not imply that a build is independently security-audited or safe from data loss.
- The project uses substantial AI assistance; implementation claims should be evaluated through source, tests, reports, and real-world validation rather than authorship assumptions.
